meta.title: Private villas in Bali
meta.description: Book private villas directly from the people who run them, with live rates and availability.

home.title: Quiet places, cared for with heart.
home.intro: Private villas with a pool, breakfast and a team that looks after every guest. Book direct at the best rate.

auth.loginIntro: Staff only. Accounts are created by an admin; there is no public sign-up.
auth.verifyIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.backupCodeIntro: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification. Each code works once.
auth.setPasswordIntro: Choose a password for your staff account. This link works only once.
auth.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence you can remember is safer than a short random word.

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.invalidCode: The code is invalid or has expired.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.noStaff: This account is not linked to an active staff member. Contact your admin.
errors.missingToken: This link is incomplete or has expired. Ask your admin for a new one.

ops.title: Operations
ops.noProperties: No properties have been assigned to you yet.
ops.comingNext: The operations dashboard (reservations, calendar, villa status) is built in Fase 2.

security.title: Two-step verification
security.intro: Every staff account must use an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password).
security.enabled: Two-step verification is on for this account.
security.step2: 2. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
security.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
security.manualKey: Cannot scan? Enter this key manually:
security.step3: 3. Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app.
security.backupIntro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes signs you in once. Store them somewhere safe now; they will not be shown again.

results.title: Available villas
results.minStay: Minimum {nights} nights for this arrival date
results.invalidDates: Invalid dates. Check-out must be after check-in.
results.pickDates: Choose dates to see prices and availability.

villa.availabilityIntro: Choose your check-in date, then your check-out date.

checkout.title: Booking details
checkout.emailHint: Your confirmation and booking link are sent here.
checkout.payInFull: Paid in full, because arrival is less than {days} days away.
checkout.depositNote: {percent}% deposit now, the rest before arrival.
checkout.policyLine: Cancel {days} or more days before check-in: fee of {percent}% of the total.
checkout.policyLast: Cancel less than {days} days before check-in: fee of {percent}% of the total.
checkout.agree: I agree to the cancellation policy.
checkout.holdNotice: When you continue, the villa is held for you for {minutes} minutes while you pay.

errors.sold_out: Sorry, this villa has just sold out for those dates. Please choose other dates or another villa.
errors.too_many_guests: The number of guests is above the villa's capacity.
errors.invalid_guest: Please check your name and email address.
errors.quote: These dates cannot be booked. Please check the minimum stay.
errors.agree: Please agree to the cancellation policy to continue.
errors.payment: We could not start the payment. Please try again shortly.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

pay.simulatedBanner: This is a development simulation. No money moves. Real payments use Xendit once its keys are installed.
pay.declined: Payment declined. The villa stays held until the timer runs out; you can try again.
pay.notFound: Payment not found or already completed.
pay.disabled: Simulated payment is not enabled in this environment.

booking.lookupIntro: Enter your booking code and the email you booked with.
booking.notFound: Booking not found. Check the code and email.
booking.title: Booking {code}
booking.pendingIntro: The villa is held until {time}. Complete the payment to confirm your booking.
booking.expiredIntro: Payment did not arrive in time, so the villa was released. Please book again.
booking.refundDue: Our team will process a refund of {amount} to your payment method.
booking.needsRefundHeading: Payment arrived after the villa was sold.
booking.needsRefundIntro: Our team will contact you and refund {amount} in full.
booking.cancelConfirm: I want to cancel this booking.
booking.saveLink: Bookmark this page to see your booking again.

footer.tagline: Private villas in Bali, looked after by a local team.
footer.demo: Development site: sample data, simulated payments.
